verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions employee option exercise, exercise payment, or share issuance resulting from an exercise. The nearby items are adjacent features that do not establish this capability: vesting alerts, e-signing, transfer-agent status, and liquidity programs for buying or selling stock. Online option exercise is a fair question for an equity-management platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an employee, I can exercise my vested options online — including payment and the resulting share issuance — without paper forms
